About UAEMUNA

Learn about our mission, vision, and the team behind UAEMUNA

Our Mission

Empowering future diplomats and global leaders through the art of diplomacy and international cooperation. We support Model United Nations conferences across the UAE by providing professional photography, volunteer coordination, and world-class event logistics.

Our Vision

To become the leading support organization for MUN conferences in the UAE, fostering a community of young diplomats committed to international cooperation and understanding. We believe in the transformative power of dialogue and negotiation.

Our Founders
👤
Youssef Abdalla

Founder

👤
Reem Alzeyoudi

Founder

👤
Raneem

Founder

Our three founders share a passion for diplomacy, international cooperation, and supporting the next generation of global leaders. Together, they founded UAEMUNA to provide comprehensive support to Model United Nations conferences across the UAE, combining their expertise in event management, volunteer coordination, and professional photography.

Our Values
Excellence

We are committed to delivering excellence in every aspect of our work, from photography to logistics.

Integrity

We operate with honesty, transparency, and strong ethical principles in all our dealings.

Collaboration

We believe in the power of teamwork and collaboration to achieve shared goals.

Empowerment

We are dedicated to empowering future diplomats and global leaders through our support.

Our Services

Comprehensive support for Model United Nations conferences

📷 Professional Photography
FREE

We provide professional-grade photography and videography services to capture the essence of your MUN conference. Our experienced photographers understand the dynamics of diplomatic events and know how to capture key moments that showcase your conference's success.

What's Included:
✓ Professional event photography throughout the conference
✓ High-resolution image editing and processing
✓ Videography and highlight reel creation
✓ Digital delivery of all media files
✓ Custom photo packages available
👥 Volunteer Coordination
FREE

Managing volunteers is critical to conference success. We handle recruitment, training, scheduling, and coordination of dedicated volunteers to ensure smooth operations throughout your event.

What's Included:
✓ Volunteer recruitment and screening
✓ Comprehensive training programs
✓ Shift scheduling and coordination
✓ On-site volunteer management
✓ Quality assurance and support
⚙️ Event Logistics
FREE

From venue setup to day-of coordination, we handle the logistics so you can focus on the diplomatic experience. Our team has extensive experience managing large-scale MUN conferences with hundreds of delegates.

What's Included:
✓ Venue coordination and setup
✓ Registration and check-in management
✓ Catering and refreshment coordination
✓ Technical support and AV setup
✓ Day-of event management and troubleshooting

Privacy Policy

Last updated: April 2026

1. Introduction

UAEMUNA ("we," "our," or "us") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you visit our website and use our services.

2. Information We Collect

We may collect information about you in a variety of ways. The information we may collect on the site includes:

• Name and email address (when you subscribe to our newsletter)
• Contact information (when you submit a contact form)
• Usage data and analytics information
• Device information (browser type, IP address)
3. How We Use Your Information

We use the information we collect in the following ways:

• To send newsletters and updates about UAEMUNA
• To respond to your inquiries and requests
• To improve our website and services
• To comply with legal obligations
4. Data Security

We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. However, no method of transmission over the Internet is 100% secure.

5. Third-Party Links

Our website may contain links to third-party websites. We are not responsible for the privacy practices of other websites. We encourage you to review the privacy policies of any third-party sites before providing your information.

6. Your Rights

You have the right to:

• Access your personal information
• Correct inaccurate information
• Request deletion of your information
• Opt-out of marketing communications
7. Contact Us

If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or our privacy practices, please contact us at uaemodelun@gmail.com
